title: Capture private Tuya identity publication custody
objective: Close credential-bearing private identity publication races while preserving admitted-root authority, exact writer digest fencing, secure cleanup, pathname identity, and package/field contracts before composition.

blockers.reason: Recovery #2858 exact cb72a47ee2489235febd40ac440bc9f8462ba432 correctly closes pre-check staging-name regular/directory/symlink substitution and its narrowed four-case Publication Races run 31475822468 is SUCCESS, but two distinct terminal-red threat classes remain. #2861 exact d29a3dc6e2d1c5db3e0661a415e619134c4a5587 has Same Inode Payload Current run 31476127075 FAILURE, proving equal-length attacker bytes can overwrite the already-sealed inode while dev/ino/link/size remain accepted because final bytes are never rebound to intended payload. Comprehensive pathname child #2868 exact d7c989d297856a5ae222a257120ee09d0ee27361 has Publication Name Binding run 31476481306 FAILURE and independently proves BOTH name re-resolution windows: source name can be swapped after the sealed-name check but before rename, and destination name can be swapped after verified final open but before success while the held descriptor still looks legitimate. A successful return therefore can coexist with attacker bytes at the credential pathname, and a rejected source substitution can leave attacker bytes there because cleanup targets the vanished temporary name. Production must bind payload bytes plus canonical destination-name identity through publication, and safely remove/quarantine only the exact inode published by this operation without blindly deleting unrelated prior/attacker state. Do not weaken either #2861 or #2868. #2858's green narrowed gate is ingredient evidence only.

Production shell order remains correct: checkout FD admission precedes writer-byte capture, digest fence, then hidden credential reads. Recovery #2858 has not yet absorbed #2733 exact 55d33a1be7b6e4ce692e316e61ee7bfa33d07376, whose unique source-contract assertion mechanically locks `root admission -> writer byte capture -> digest fence -> credentials`; the current weaker test only proves admission/digest each precede credentials. Preserve #2733 in the final recovery.

Inherited Field Build Provenance previously reached the private writer self-test on macOS and failed because trusted temporary `/var` ancestry can traverse the platform `/var -> /private/var` symlink while absolute no-follow root admission rejects it. Fix only the trusted self-test root/canonicalization path; do not weaken production admitted-checkout no-symlink custody. Revalidate on the eventual moved exact recovery after writer bytes, destination-name authority, digest, and package contracts stabilize.
